title: BanglaNews8
author: Ar-Rafi Islam, Tanzir Hossain, Shrizon, MEHEDI, MD HUMAION KABIR
description: The dataset comprises 118,404 Bangla news articles, collected using web scraping tools like Selenium from reputable Bangla news websites such as Kalerkantha, Diganta, and Jugantor. It includes eight distinct categories: Political news: 10.7% Technology news: 8.4% Educational news: 10.8% State news: 12.8% International news: 12.9% Sports news: 14.1%
